## Clinical justification

On examination there is a palpable rectal mass in the lower rectum. The patient has experienced rectal bleeding on at least three separate occasions over the past four weeks. She also reports a change in bowel habit with stools becoming softer and more frequent. Digital rectal examination is uncomfortable. No other explanation found.
